$comment: Canonical logical ProviderCapabilities schema for the 2026-09-22 architecture-hardening checkpoint.

ProviderCapabilities.failure_domain: declared operator/cloud/account/region/ASN-like hints used by local policy; never trusted as cryptographic proof of independence
ProviderCapabilities.privacy_properties: declared metadata/trust characteristics, preferably structured as/linked to a MetadataExposureDescriptor; provider assertions are not cryptographic proof
ProviderCapabilities.abuse_controls: declared admission/rate-limit/ticket and optional safety-advisory/report-target capabilities where applicable; never universal protocol authority
ProviderCapabilities.security_properties: declared provider-local security features; not protocol authority

Rule: Protocol core branches on capabilities/policy, not vendor name. Co-hosted provider roles remain logically separable and failure-domain declarations are hints, not trusted security identity.
